patch.objective: Designing data validation into a pipeline

sources.cite: Google Cloud, Professional Data Engineer exam guide v4.2: Designing data processing systems (~22%), Ingesting and processing the data (~25%), Storing the data (~20%), Preparing and using data for analysis (~15%), Maintaining and automating data workloads (~18%)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch of the PDF on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 3.1 'Planning for storage costs and performance'. The guide does not name partitioning or clustering. (read for this round by an earlier pass on 2026-11-17)

sources.cite: TensorFlow, 'Get started with TensorFlow Data Validation'
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: validate_statistics 'matches the statistics of the dataset against the schema and marks any discrepancies'; a feature's presence is set by presence.min_fraction; out-of-domain values are anomalies; if it is a real data error 'the underlying data should be fixed before using it for training'; drift between training days is checked with drift_comparator and previous_statistics (Jensen-Shannon divergence covers numeric features). The pipeline's components and commands are authored renderings on Agent Platform Pipelines.
